create_MoEActivation_enum: create a MoEActivation enum instance from a string name like 'silu' or 'gelu_no_mul'
run_apply_moe_activation: run MoE activation on two 2D torch tensors using a specified activation type
test_MoEActivation_is_gated: test whether a MoEActivation enum member is a gated activation variant
build_activation_without_mul: build the non-gated variant string name from a gated activation function name
review_MoEActivation_custom_op_name: review the custom C++ op name mapped to a MoEActivation enum member
